Why LumiWear

Made for the moments after sunset

We keep our collection small and focused, so every item gets the attention it deserves — from fabric choice to the final stitch.

About us

Hi, we're LumiWear.

We make comfortable everyday clothing with a little bit of light in it.

Our story

LumiWear was created for people who live their lives well past sunset — evening walks, late-night city trips, concerts and festivals. We wanted clothes that feel great all day and have a small surprise once the lights go down.

That surprise is our glowing star. Printed or stitched with glow-in-the-dark materials, it charges in daylight or under a lamp and softly lights up in the dark. No batteries, no wires — just a little magic.

What we stand for

Better materials

We use organic cotton and recycled polyester wherever we can, and we choose fabrics that last.

Small, focused collections

Fewer pieces, made with more care. We'd rather perfect one hoodie than release ten average ones.

Real, personal service

Every message is answered by a real person on our small team — usually within one working day.

Ready to find your glow?

Explore the full collection of hoodies, tees, joggers and accessories.

Help centre

Frequently asked questions

Can't find your answer? Send us a message and we'll help you out.

Orders & payment

How do I place an order?

Add the items you want to your cart, open the cart and fill in your details in the checkout form. After you press Place order we'll email you within 24 hours to confirm everything and send a secure payment link.

Which payment methods do you accept?

Our secure payment link supports iDEAL, credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), PayPal and bank transfer.

Can I change or cancel my order?

Yes — as long as your order hasn't shipped. Just reply to your confirmation email or send us a message through the contact page and we'll update it.

Shipping & returns

How much does shipping cost?

Shipping is free on orders over €50. Below that we charge a flat €4.95. Every order is sent with tracking.

How long does delivery take?

Orders ship within 1–2 working days after payment. Delivery takes 1–3 working days in the Netherlands and Belgium and 3–7 working days to other EU countries.

What is your return policy?

You can return unworn, unwashed items with their tags within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. See Shipping & Returns for the steps.

Products & sizing

How does the glow-in-the-dark print work?

The print contains a safe, non-toxic photoluminescent pigment. It charges in daylight or under a lamp in a few minutes and then glows for up to several hours, fading gradually. It works again and again — no batteries needed.

How do I find my size?

Our tops have a regular unisex fit. Chest width (flat, in cm): XS 48 · S 51 · M 54 · L 57 · XL 60 · XXL 63. If you're between sizes or prefer a looser fit, size up. The Radiant Oversized Tee is cut wide on purpose — size down for a regular fit.

How should I wash my LumiWear?

Wash inside out at 30°C with similar colours, don't use bleach or fabric softener, and tumble dry low or hang dry. Don't iron directly on the print. This keeps the glow bright for longer.

Help

Shipping & Returns

Shipping costs

  • Orders over €50: free shipping
  • Orders under €50: €4.95 flat rate
  • Every order is sent with a tracking code.

Delivery times

Orders are packed and shipped within 1–2 working days after payment.

  • Netherlands & Belgium: 1–3 working days
  • Other EU countries: 3–7 working days

Outside the EU? Contact us and we'll see what we can do.

Returns

You have 30 days after delivery to return your items. Items must be unworn, unwashed and have their original tags attached.

  1. Send us a message through the contact page with your order number and the items you want to return.
  2. We'll reply with the return address and instructions.
  3. Pack the items securely and send them back. Return shipping costs are for the customer, unless the item is faulty or we made a mistake.
  4. Once we receive and check your return, we refund you within 5 working days using your original payment method.

Exchanges

Need a different size or colour? Mention it in your return message and we'll send the new item as soon as your return is on its way.

Faulty or wrong items

Received something damaged or not what you ordered? Let us know within 14 days with a photo and we'll replace it or refund you, including shipping costs.

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

LumiWear respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it and what your rights are under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

What we collect

  • Order details: your name, email address, shipping address and the products you order.
  • Messages: your name, email address and the content of messages you send through our contact form.
  • Newsletter: your email address, if you subscribe.

Why we use it

  • To process, ship and support your order.
  • To answer your questions.
  • To send our newsletter, only if you subscribed. Every email has an unsubscribe link.

Who we share it with

We only share data with services we need to run the shop: our website host (Netlify, which processes form submissions), our payment provider and our delivery partner. We never sell your data.

Cookies and local storage

We don't use tracking or advertising cookies. Your cart is saved in your own browser's local storage so it's still there when you come back. It never leaves your device until you place an order.

How long we keep it

Order data is kept for 7 years because of tax law. Messages are deleted after 12 months. Newsletter data is deleted as soon as you unsubscribe.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your personal data, or object to how we use it, at any time. Send us a request through the contact page and we'll respond within 30 days. You also have the right to file a complaint with your national data protection authority.

Legal

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: October 2026

1. General

These terms apply to every order placed through the LumiWear website. By placing an order you agree to these terms.

2. Prices

All prices are in euros (€) and include VAT. Shipping costs are shown in your cart before you order. We may change prices at any time, but the price shown when you placed your order is the price you pay.

3. Ordering and payment

After you place an order you receive an email with an order confirmation and a secure payment link. The purchase agreement is final once payment is received. If payment isn't completed within 7 days, the order is cancelled automatically.

4. Delivery

We aim to ship within 1–2 working days after payment. Delivery times are an estimate; a delay does not entitle you to compensation, but you may cancel your order for a full refund if delivery takes more than 30 days.

5. Right of withdrawal

You have the right to withdraw from your purchase within 30 days of delivery without giving a reason, as described on our Shipping & Returns page. Items must be returned unworn, unwashed and with their tags attached.

6. Warranty

Our products meet the reasonable expectations you may have of them. Faults caused by normal wear, incorrect washing or misuse are not covered. Report faulty items within 14 days of discovering the fault.

7. Complaints

Not happy with something? Let us know through the contact page. We'll respond within 2 working days and aim to find a solution within 14 days. You can also use the EU Online Dispute Resolution platform at ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.

8. Applicable law

These terms are governed by Dutch law, without affecting the consumer protection rules of your country of residence.
